The '''Gold Mine''' is a location that is focused on {{Skill|Mining}}. It has various ores and houses {{NPC|Rusty}}. {{Skill|Mining 1}} is required to access the '''Gold Mine'''.

{{ZoneText 
|Talk to the Lazy Miner.
|Mine for gold, iron, and coal.
|Visit the Iron and Gold Forgers.
|Visit the Blacksmith.
|Talk to Rusty.
}}

== Purpose ==
The mine consists of {{Item|Coal Ore}}, {{Item|Iron Ore}}, {{Item|Gold Ore}} and {{Item|Stone}}.

== Trivia ==
* The {{NPC|Blacksmith}} in the '''Gold Mine''' is the same one as the one in the {{Zone|Village}}.
* If traveled to without the launcher (with an {{Item|Aspect of the End}} or {{Item|Grappling Hook}}), the inside of the '''Gold Mine''' is partly made of [[Sponge]]. Such is the case with many other areas, like the former {{Zone|Blazing Fortress}} or {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}.
* The minecart can be pushed inside the wall, then nudged away in order to get it off of the track. <!-- what minecart? -->
